title: Ledger reconciliation and monitor lifecycle planning
objective: Implement a pure deterministic module that reconciles terminal transition ledgers into orchestration state and decides whether the single Work monitor should be rearmed, paused, or left enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Validate terminal ledgers and derive a stable ledger event id.
Reconcile pass and human-required ledgers without mutating inputs.
Suppress duplicate ledger reconciliation using last_processed_event.
On pass, optionally arm one next task while preserving predecessor audit identity.
Expose a pure monitor lifecycle decision enforcing at most one matching monitor.

Return rearm for an active non-human task when its matching monitor is disabled or missing; noop when one matching monitor is already enabled; pause when no active task; human for human-required state.
